evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: dark slate node clump fills the top-centre core of the khaki colony while the flanks stay teal-lit; by shot-20s the core is smaller and the dial arrow sits above the 20 cm/s tick.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: one line-stroked L-system colony with a flow dial, hairline halos and a dark core; no material, lighting or second layer is visible, so a single rendering idea carries the piece.
evidence.craft: shot-08s: thin teal strokes and hairline halos on flat khaki; the dark core is a dense tangle of overlapping slate strokes that reads as scribble, and the caption sits small at the bottom edge.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: khaki ground with celadon branching coral and no grid, tiles or sand; it differs from the apricot sand grid, dendrite type and ochre Penrose kites of recent nights, though its cream tone is close to the Penrose strip.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: colony centred and fully framed with the dial low; by shot-20s the colony shrinks with clear margin and the dark core persists, so the 20s frame resolves rather than repeating the 2s frame.

verdict.pairwise_justification: shot-08s vs median: the Penrose strip has dense ochre and rust kites with strong contrast on cream, while tonight's thin teal strokes on khaki and the dark-slate clump read fainter, so the median wins the vote.

critique.change: At shot-08s replace the overplotted dark strokes in the core with fewer slate node fills and dimmed halos so the stagnant pocket reads as a shaped region with a clear edge rather than scribble.
Add a second rendering idea such as shaded tube depth or soft occlusion on shielded tips, so shot-02s and shot-08s show shelter as light falling off inside the colony, not only as line colour.
Enlarge the 20 cm/s tick and dial readout and let the dial visibly cross it at 6 s, so the threshold reads from the frame itself, not from the small caption at the bottom edge.

evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: flow dial reads 9.0 cm/s below its 20 cm/s tick over a mirrored celadon branch colony; by shot-08s at 22.4 cm/s the tips go dark slate, but the lit khaki outer shell barely reads.
evidence.ambition: shot-02s: one rendering idea, shaded spheres on thin links, plus a flow dial inset; shot-08s adds a colony-wide dark state change, and no halos, second layer or new rendering idea appears by shot-20s.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: clean khaki ground and soft-shaded celadon spheres with no visible artefacts at full size; shot-08s dark slate tips lose separation from the ground, and the rose accent glow at shot-20s is blurred.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: khaki ground with celadon and slate spheres on a mirrored branched colony differs from the apricot sand grid, the dendrite lettering and the ochre Penrose kites of the recent nights; rose tips add one accent.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: colony sits right of centre with empty khaki upper-left, a composed start; shot-20s returns to a lit state with the dial back under 20 cm/s, so the loop resolves, but its layout stays close to shot-02s.

verdict.pairwise_justification: shot-08s is mostly dark slate spheres on khaki, while the median's shot-20s packs dense ochre and rust kites into a triangle with visible growth; the Penrose frame is the stronger head-to-head image.

critique.change: At shot-08s keep the outer khaki shell at full brightness above the 20 cm/s tick, so the dark core contrasts with a lit rim instead of the whole colony going dark slate.
Add the boundary-layer halo from the brief as translucent khaki rings around branch tips, a second rendering idea visible in shot-08s and shot-20s beyond shaded spheres on lines.
Change the shot-20s composition: pull the camera back so the colony sits smaller with margin, giving the loop a distinct end state rather than a near-copy of the shot-02s layout.

evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: about a thousand khaki-lit tips in a fan-shaped mirrored colony, dial at 10 cm/s with no dark nodes; by shot-08s the dial reads 25 cm/s and a dark slate cluster forms in the upper centre under a lit khaki shell.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: roughly a thousand nodes in three visible states (khaki, dark slate, rose tips), faint halos and a live flow dial, all on one flat 2D canvas; shot-20s keeps the same single layer at smaller scale.
evidence.craft: shot-08s: flat dots render cleanly at 1280 px with no visible aliasing, but the halos are barely visible and the dark core reads as a grey smudge where tips overlap; shot-20s is equally clean.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: khaki-sage fan of branching tips on a slate ground, unlike the apricot sand grid, the ochre Penrose kites or the dendrite typography of the last three nights; its earthy palette overlaps slightly with the Penrose piece.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: colony centred with an even margin and already composed; by shot-20s it has shrunk to roughly a third of the frame width in a mostly empty field, so the piece resolves but loses weight.

verdict.pairwise_justification: Head-to-head, tonight's 8s frame has a dark slate core against a lit khaki shell that reads at a glance; the median's cream ground holds one ochre kite triangle whose detail is fine but low-contrast.

critique.change: Re-frame shot-20s so the colony stays near its shot-08s scale with a tighter margin; the current pull-back shrinks it to about a third of the frame and leaves the dark core too small to read at a glance.
At shot-08s give the stagnant core a clear edge: thin out the dark slate tips at the core boundary so an empty pocket shows inside the khaki shell instead of a grey cloud of overlapping dots.
Make the boundary-layer halos visible at shot-08s: raise the halo alpha around lit tips so the khaki haze between branches becomes a second rendering layer rather than a faint ring around a few tips.
